name: Jace Beleren
description: A mind mage and planeswalker who wakes on an island with no memory of who he is, and rediscovers his gift for illusions.

name: Malcolm
description: A member of the Belligerent's crew.

name: The Belligerent
description: A tall ship with brilliantly colored sails, captained by the gorgon who finds Jace.

name: Useless Island
description: The jungle island where Jace wakes without his memory, named by him in frustration.

name: Vraska
description: A gorgon who captains the ship the Belligerent and knows Jace; this page does not name her.
